summary.name: Monodraw
summary.one_liner: Monodraw is a macOS ASCII art editor for creating text-based diagrams, layouts, flow charts, and text banners.
use_cases: Drawing ASCII diagrams for code comments and documentation
Creating flow charts and layouts in plain text
Generating text banners with FIGlet fonts
Auto-generating docs via version control hooks using the CLI
Visualising data structures, algorithms and binary formats
summary.what_it_does: Monodraw lets you draw text-based art on an infinite canvas using shapes, lines, and text boxes, then copy the result as plain text into any editor. It supports orthogonal and staircase lines with attachment points that keep connections intact when shapes move. Rectangles can have borders, backgrounds, shadows, and custom attachment points. Text banners are made with built-in FIGlet support and 148 bundled fonts, and Crow's Foot ER diagram notation is supported in three variants. The page also describes a command-line interface and JSON output, and image export to PNG and SVG.
notable: Built-in FIGlet text banners with 148 bundled fonts
Crow's Foot ER diagram notation in three variants
Command-line interface and JSON output (direct download version only)
Attachment points keep lines connected when shapes move
caveats: Requires macOS 11 Big Sur or later; older versions v1.3 and v1.5 exist for earlier macOS releases
Command-line tool is only in the version downloaded directly from the website, not the Mac App Store
Educational pricing is available on request; standard price not stated on the page
